subject: UniProtKB:P00099

subject: UniProtKB:P23926
description: Expression-level regulatory support under tested PAO1 nitrate/anaerobic conditions; no direct catalytic activation/inhibition or IHF CHA-A2 strain transfer is inferred.

evidence.source_assertion: This current UniProtKB reviewed (Swiss-Prot) entry assigns P23926 to taxon 208964, anr / PA1544, with a 244-residue sequence. It does not establish sequence identity to every historical preparation.
Anr is essential for anaerobic narK1 promoter activity; promoter motif mutation and complementation support the expression effect.

subject: UniProtKB:G3XCW6
description: Expression-level regulatory support under tested PAO1 nitrate/anaerobic conditions; no direct catalytic activation/inhibition or IHF CHA-A2 strain transfer is inferred.

evidence.source_assertion: This current UniProtKB unreviewed (TrEMBL) entry assigns G3XCW6 to taxon 208964, dnr / PA0527, with a 227-residue sequence. It does not establish sequence identity to every historical preparation.
Dnr deletion decreases anaerobic narK1 promoter activity and complementation supports an enhancing expression role.

subject: UniProtKB:Q9HXD3
description: Expression-level regulatory support under tested PAO1 nitrate/anaerobic conditions; no direct catalytic activation/inhibition or IHF CHA-A2 strain transfer is inferred.

evidence.source_assertion: This current UniProtKB unreviewed (TrEMBL) entry assigns Q9HXD3 to taxon 208964, narL / PA3879, with a 219-residue sequence. It does not establish sequence identity to every historical preparation.
NarL deletion lowers narK1 promoter activity, complementation nearly restores it, and selected promoter-site mutations abolish reporter activity.
